scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
Now Basta is in charge of refinement for shadow items.
If you'd like to refine a shadow item, please visit him.
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
现在巴斯塔负责影子装备的精炼。
如果您想精炼影子装备，请去找他。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
Do you want to refine a shadow item? Pick yer poison!
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
想精炼影子装备？选吧！

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
When a shadow item is refined, it gains extra bonuses very much like normal items.
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
影子装备和普通装备一样，精炼后会获得额外加成。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
Weapon: ATK, MATK + 1 increase for each +1 refine success.
Etc: HP + 10 increase for each +1 refine success.
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
武器：精炼值每提升1，ATK、MATK各+1
其他部位：精炼值每提升1，HP+10

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
All types of Oridecon and Elunium can be used to refine shadow items. Each attempt will also cost 20,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
所有种类的神之金属和铝都可以用来精炼影子装备。每次尝试还需要支付20,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
HD ores can be used for gear that is at least refine level +7 and will prevent breaking as long as you stay talking to me.
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
高浓缩矿石可用于精炼值+7及以上的装备。
只要不结束与我的对话，就能避免装备损毁。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
There's nothing here!
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
这里什么都没有！

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
I require {0} zeny as a fee for EACH refine attempt.
Choose your Ore and start refining.
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
每次精炼收取{0} Zeny。
选好矿石就开始吧。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
HD Ore can only used for +7 or higher refine level items.
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
高浓缩矿石只能用于精炼值+7及以上的装备。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
You've cancelled refining.
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
您已取消精炼。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
You do not have enough {0}.
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
您的{0}不足。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
You do not have enough zeny.
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
您的Zeny不足。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
Shadow Equipment can be refined to the maximum of 10...
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
影子装备最高可以精炼到+10...

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
This item cannot be refined.
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
该物品无法精炼。

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
The safety refine level for Shadow Equipment is +4.
Shadow equipment may be destroyed in subsequent refinements. Want to get started?
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
影子装备的安全精炼值是+4，超过后继续精炼，装备可能损毁。
要开始吗？

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
The safety refine level for Shadow Equipment is +4.
The next refinement, if it fails, will degrade the refinement. Do you want to refine?
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
影子装备的安全精炼值是+4，这次精炼若失败，精炼值会降低。
还要精炼吗？

scripts.text: Proceed
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
Heh, I knew it!
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
嘿嘿，我就知道！

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
Well then.. here goes nothing!
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
那么...豁出去了！

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
It worked! It worked!
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
成功了！成功了！

scripts.text:
[Shadow Blacksmith]
Oh Odin No!
scripts.translation:
[影子铁匠]
奥丁啊，不——！
